headline: Revenue and gross profit up; EPS flat
summary_short: Revenue $25.3B was +6.6% y/y and +5.2% q/q; EPS $2.30 was flat y/y.
summary_long: Revenue $25.3B advanced 6.6% year-over-year and 5.2% sequentially, feeding into $17.3B of gross profit (up 7.1% y/y). Net income of $5.53B held flat versus prior year (-0.1% y/y) but rose 5.7% sequentially. EPS basic came in at $2.30, unchanged from the year-ago quarter and up 6.0% sequentially. Gross margin ticked to 68.2% from 67.9% y/y.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
